♈ The Aries Cloth. [DEFENSE]

Cloth Passive — Cloth Mending

You are trained in Crafting. You can Repair any Cloth, armor, or shield in 10 minutes with no check and no repair kit, restoring 10 × your level Hit Points. A Cloth you repair is fully restored regardless of how it was destroyed.

Techniques

  • 1st — Signature (L1) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crystal Wall]
  • 2nd (L6) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Starlight Extinction]
  • 3rd — Cloth Ability (L11) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Crystal Net]
  • 4th — Ultimate (L16) — @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Stardust Revolution]

Ascendant Boon — Star Guard [DEFENSE]

+2 status bonus to AC and to all saves.

Reaction (once per round): when a creature within 60 feet makes a ranged or spell attack, or targets an ally with a spell, the effect is sent nowhere — expended, no result.

You also gain Dimension Step ◆ (teleport 60 feet).

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Aries)]

Zenith Boon — Star Guard (Zenith) [DEFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, and the reaction has no frequency limit.

Once per minute you may target a creature with the reaction instead: 60 feet, Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC, and on a critical failure it is teleported one mile away. Incapacitation.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Zenith (Aries)]
